definition: One comparison per event group and travel direction, 15-minute windows before and after the change: (effect station after - before) - (control station after - before). Only clean windows with vehicles in all four windows, no window under 30 vehicles, control not contaminated (Gold v2 rules). Pooled over all comparisons; not specific to a station. 95 % CIs with errors clustered by zone.

regression.outcome: mean speed effect minus control (km/h), 15-minute windows
regression.formula: mean_speed ~ limit_change + limit_change:dry + dry + pre_trend_diff + hour period dummies (day 9-15 is the reference); limit_change = new - old km/h

card.label: Speed change per km/h of limit change, wet road
Speed change per km/h of limit change, dry road

regression.card_note: Adjusted for the pre-existing trend and the time of day.

per km/h of limit change (new - old), wet road
extra per km/h of limit change on a dry road
dry instead of wet road (at no limit change)
per km/h of pre-trend difference (effect - control)
night (22-6 h) instead of day (9-15 h)
morning peak (6-9 h) instead of day (9-15 h)

regression.note: Coefficients only; the browser does not predict with them. Errors clustered by zone.

not_covered: Rerouting: drivers choosing other roads because of the limit is not measured.
Best route / travel time over a whole route: the stations measure points, not routes.
Incidents: only 20 event groups had an active incident, too few to separate.
Weather other than a dry or a wet (moist or wet) road surface: snow, ice, fog, darkness.
Effects longer than the first 15 minutes after the change (Gold v2 has 30 and 60 minutes only as sensitivity).
Station-specific effects: the numbers are pooled over all comparisons, not estimated per station.
Change sizes or combinations not observed in the week (see the N on each card).
Winter, holidays and other seasons: the data is one week of late September 2026.

headroom.definition: Share of vehicles over the lower of the two limits in the effect station's 15-minute before window (recomputed from LAM raw, Gold v2 vehicles). Past changes with under 50 % are few; the page notes it when the station's normal share over the lower limit at that hour is under 50 %.
